suitability_reason: EITC qualifying-child residency test and HOH half-year abode test decided mechanically on found days of residence (about 60 days).

taxpayer.notes: Unmarried grandmother and court-appointed guardian (since 2007) of minor grandchild A.V.

adjustments: disallowed earned income credit claimed with A.V. as qualifying child
changed filing status from head of household to single and adjusted standard deduction
notice_of_deficiency.contested_by_taxpayer: Claims A.V. is her qualifying child for EITC and HOH.

findings_of_fact.fact: Petitioner is A.V.'s grandmother and court-appointed guardian since 2007
findings_of_fact.snippet: Petitioner is the grandmother of A.V. 1 and has been A.V.’s court appointed guardian since 2007.

findings_of_fact.fact: At close of 2020 petitioner was unmarried and A.V. was a minor
findings_of_fact.snippet: As of the close of 2020, petitioner was not married and A.V. was a minor.

findings_of_fact.fact: A.V. lived at a friend's house most of the year and with petitioner approximately 60 days in 2020
findings_of_fact.snippet: For most of the year, A.V. lived at a friend’s house. A.V. lived with petitioner for approximately 60 days during 2020.

findings_of_fact.fact: A.V. was not employed in 2020; petitioner helped pay A.V.'s rent, phone, clothing, food, transportation and other expenses
No individual other than A.V. is suggested as a qualifying child
findings_of_fact.snippet: Petitioner does not suggest that any individual other than A.V. fits the definition of her qualifying child.

issues.question: Is petitioner entitled to the 2020 EITC as an eligible individual with A.V. as qualifying child?
issues.holding: No; A.V. did not share petitioner's principal place of abode for more than one-half of 2020. No finding on credit for an eligible individual without a qualifying child (left to Rule 155).
issues.computable_reason: Residency test: ~60 days is not more than one-half of the year.

issues.question: Does petitioner qualify for head of household filing status for 2020?
issues.holding: No; her home was not the principal place of abode for more than half of 2020 of a qualifying child or dependent; single status and corresponding standard deduction sustained.
issues.computable_reason: Half-year abode test fails on 60 days.

decision.text: Decision will be entered under Rule 155.
decision.summary: EITC with qualifying child denied; HOH denied (single status); Rule 155 computation may reflect no-child EITC if parties agree.

notes: Some facts stipulated. Deficiency amount not stated in opinion. Footnote 2: court makes no finding whether petitioner qualifies for the EITC without a qualifying child; parties may reflect it in Rule 155 computations. Burden on petitioner.
